If the surface area of a cube is increasing at a rate of 48 cm2/s, at what rate are the edges changing when each edge is 2 cm? Assume that each edge is increasing at the same rate.

a
16 cm/s
b
4 cm/s
c
2 cm/s
d
8 cm/s
e
10 cm/s
